主要内容: On July 7, 2014, SAP AG completed its conversion into a European Company (Societas Europaea, SE). Effective from the entry into the commercial register at the Local Court of Mannheim, SAP AG now operates and reports as SAP SE. The conversion was approved by the required 75% majority of shareholders at the Annual General Meeting in 2014. SAP SE remains headquartered in Walldorf, Germany. Shareholders of SAP AG automatically became shareholders of SAP SE without any changes to their rights. The conversion did not affect SAP's financial reporting practices. The form of American Depositary Receipt reflecting this conversion is attached as Exhibit 4.1.
